policy.endpoint: ES endpoint-state continuation summaries. Independent position/AVR-controlled comparison findings are recorded in provenance.
policy.firstBreach: Baseline by ES/window/side/type. Only ES time-block comparisons passing the pre-specified independent ES screen may adjust estimates. Closing-strength experiment disabled by default.
policy.intervals: Unadjusted Wilson reference intervals for raw cells, not confidence intervals for shrunk estimates.
